At its most basic level, an operating system manages your hardware.
In a nutshell, an OS is:
A software abstraction layer for hardware
file systems to access disk memory
enabling multiple processes to use i/o like wifi
preventing processes from interfering with one another
We will be spending more time on the first 2 aspects than the 3rd.
We also won’t be looking at the OS as a whole:
